qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Proprietary NEXBTL technology and extensive waste feedstock supply chain provide operational scale, but renewable products are commodity price-takers whose margins depend on volatile regulatory credit values and face competitor capacity oversupply.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Global renewable diesel and SAF leader, but operates as a price-taker subject to regulatory subsidy swings (RINs, LCFS) and massive competitor capacity additions, causing severe margin volatility and sub-hurdle downcycle ROIC.
qualitative.evidence: Renewable product sales margins collapsed from >$800/ton to $377/ton in 2024 as global capacity surged, driving free cash flow negative (-EUR 341M). Margins reflect regulatory mandate arbitrage rather than structural pricing power.
